normal.desc: 請唸出：正式邀請不保證有實質影響力
normal.ans: A FORMAL INVITATION DOES NOT GUARANTEE GENUINE INFLUENCE
normal.speak: a formal invitation does not guarantee genuine influence
normal.vocabId: R7:A FORMAL INVITATION DOES NOT GUARANTEE GENUINE INFLUENCE

normal.desc: 請拼出：依情況自行判斷決定的裁量權（D 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：明確交付的任務或授權（M 開頭，7 個字母）
請拼出：為達協議而放寬原要求的讓步（C 開頭，10 個字母）
填空題：A R B I T _ A T I O N (由第三方作出裁決以解決爭議的過程)
填空題：R E C _ P R _ C A L (彼此相互對應的)
填空題：L E _ E _ A _ E (可用來影響他人決定的籌碼或優勢)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 已完全消除的不快
B. 向別人提供禮物的方式
C. 確定錯過某班交通工具
D. 對某項安排是否妥當的疑慮
normal.explain: misgiving 是不安疑慮，不是misgiving字面錯送禮。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 說話行事顧及他人感受而得體的
B. 因害怕而完全無法表達
C. 為顯優越而故意尖刻的
D. 刻意省略所有必要資訊的
normal.explain: tactful 強調分寸，未必等於隱瞞或不表態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 事先已保證會被接受的道歉
B. 有所保留而未完全承認的道歉
C. 所有責任都明確承認的道歉
D. 只有取得資格者才能說的道歉
normal.explain: qualified 指附有限定，並非專業資格。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: His silence is open to interpretation; it should not be recruited as evidence of agreement.
options: A. 他的沉默可有不同解讀，不應直接被拿來當同意證據。
B. 他的沉默已明確表示全盤支持。
C. 只有沉默才能證明真正同意。
D. 說話者已確認沉默必定表示敵意。
normal.explain: 不確定反應不能被單一方向挪用為證據。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The difficulty is that an invitation to be candid can coexist with a strong expectation that candour will be reassuring.
options: A. 坦白只可能讓所有人感到不快。
B. 困難在於邀請坦白，同時又強烈期待坦白內容必須令人安心。
C. 邀請坦白已排除對回應內容的任何期待。
D. 令人安心的話必定不坦白。
normal.explain: 張力在真誠表達與預期答案之間，不把安心和坦白一概互斥。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am less troubled by the disagreement than by the pretence that there is no disagreement to discuss.
options: A. 我已證明大家其實沒有不同意見。
B. 我只是在反對使用討論這個字。
C. 比起分歧本身，我更在意假裝沒有分歧可談。
D. 我認為只要有分歧就應停止一切討論。
normal.explain: 比較關切焦點，不是否認分歧存在。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: There is a difference between making allowances for a difficult situation and allowing the same explanation to end every discussion.
options: A. 每次討論都已改用不同的解釋。
B. 體諒困境與讓同一理由終止每次討論不同。
C. 只要體諒就必須停止提出任何問題。
D. 困境永遠不能影響對行為的評價。
normal.explain: 體諒不等於無限豁免檢視。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What passes for harmony may depend on one person continuously absorbing inconvenience that the others do not have to notice.
options: A. 只要表面和諧就能確定沒有任何代價。
B. 說話者否認任何共同生活可以和諧。
C. 看似和諧，可能仰賴一人不斷承擔其他人不必注意的不便。
D. 所有人已平均分攤每種不便。
normal.explain: 對和諧來源提出分配層次的可能解釋。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The boundary is being presented as a withdrawal of affection, which makes discussing a practical limit unnecessarily difficult.
options: A. 提出界線已明確等於結束所有關係。
B. 說話者認為感情完全不影響任何溝通。
C. 大家已接受界線而不再有誤解。
D. 實際界線被說成收回感情，讓討論具體限制變得不必要地困難。
normal.explain: 將行為範圍與感情忠誠混同，抬高溝通代價。

normal.desc: 【語意】Her reserve was mistaken for disapproval. What was confused?
options: A. An explicit objection and a formal apology.
B. A lack of attendance and a lack of opportunity.
C. A firm refusal and enthusiastic agreement.
D. A restrained manner and a negative judgement.
normal.explain: reserve 是少表露的態度，不必表示否定評價。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which verb means to reduce a worry? The remark was intended to ___ her concerns.
options: A. allay
B. arouse
C. disguise
D. document
normal.explain: allay 指減輕疑慮；arouse 引起，disguise 掩飾，document 記錄。

normal.desc: 【文法】Had she been told about the change, she ___ her plans accordingly.
options: A. had been adjust
B. would have adjusted
C. would adjusting
D. will have adjust
normal.explain: 過去反事實條件 Had...been told 對應 would have＋過去分詞。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which adjective describes a relationship in which friendly feelings are returned by both people?
options: A. reciprocal
B. incidental
C. peripheral
D. provisional
normal.explain: reciprocal 指相互回應；不是偶然、邊緣或暫定。

normal.desc: 【短文】A friend says she wants an honest opinion, but responds to every reservation by asking whether the speaker supports her at all. What tension is evident?
options: A. Support has been defined as agreement to cancel the plan.
B. A request for evaluation is being treated as a test of loyalty.
C. The speaker has been asked to provide no opinion.
D. Every reservation has already been accepted as useful.
normal.explain: 誠實評價與忠誠確認被混同，可能限制保留意見。

normal.desc: 【語意】The explanation is offered in mitigation, not as an excuse. Which distinction is intended?
options: A. It replaces every factual account with an apology.
B. It insists that consequences are irrelevant to judgement.
C. It asks for the conduct to be judged in context without denying responsibility.
D. It claims that no responsibility can attach to the conduct.
normal.explain: mitigation 可減輕評價，不必免除責任。

normal.desc: 【立場】The apology recognises the inconvenience while stopping short of acknowledging the breach of trust. What remains unaddressed?
options: A. Whether the practical problem existed at all.
B. The relational harm beyond the immediate practical difficulty.
C. Whether any inconvenience has been acknowledged.
D. Whether the apologiser has used a polite formula.
normal.explain: 承認不便不等於承認信任受損。

normal.desc: 【短文】Two flatmates agree that chores should be shared fairly. One counts tasks, the other counts time and unpleasantness. Both believe they have followed the agreement. What is the central problem?
options: A. Fairness has been proved impossible to discuss.
B. Every task necessarily takes exactly the same effort.
C. The shared term fair has not been translated into a mutually understood criterion.
D. Neither person has accepted any obligation to contribute.
normal.explain: 抽象共識未化成相同衡量標準，可能各自真誠但理解不同。

normal.desc: 【語用】I would not wish to intrude, but I wonder whether you have considered how this affects the rest of us. What is the likely function?
options: A. A declaration that no one else is affected.
B. A request for permission to enter a locked room.
C. An unconditional endorsement of the decision.
D. A tactful challenge to a decision framed as merely personal.
normal.explain: 禮貌鋪墊後指出對他人的影響，對純私人決定框架提出質疑。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：不輕易表露想法感受的
請唸出單字：與周遭情境不相稱的
請唸出：沒有明說卻彼此默認的理解
請唸出：有合理根據的保留
請唸出：表面和諧可能掩蓋不均等負擔
normal.ans: APPARENT HARMONY CAN CONCEAL AN UNEQUAL BURDEN
normal.speak: apparent harmony can conceal an unequal burden
normal.vocabId: R7:APPARENT HARMONY CAN CONCEAL AN UNEQUAL BURDEN

normal.desc: 請唸出：實際界線不必意味感情退縮
normal.ans: A PRACTICAL BOUNDARY NEED NOT IMPLY EMOTIONAL WITHDRAWAL
normal.speak: a practical boundary need not imply emotional withdrawal
normal.vocabId: R7:A PRACTICAL BOUNDARY NEED NOT IMPLY EMOTIONAL WITHDRAWAL

normal.desc: 請拼出：對某項安排是否妥當的疑慮（M 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：使關係或衝突重新調和的過程（R 開頭，14 個字母）
請拼出：同時懷有矛盾感受的（A 開頭，10 個字母）
填空題：T A C _ F U L (顧及他人感受而有分寸的)
填空題：C A _ D _ U R (坦率表達真實看法的特性)
填空題：F O _ B E _ R A _ C E (在可生氣或責備時仍克制容忍)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 遇到問題時可尋求的補救或求助途徑
B. 旅程最初出發的地點
C. 不需要申請就已獲得的名額
D. 每個人必須接受的同一處罰
normal.explain: recourse 指可求助或補救的方法。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 完全不容更改的唯一安排
B. 因應可能意外情況的備案
C. 保證所有意外不會發生的承諾
D. 只記錄已結束旅程的清單
normal.explain: contingency plan 為可能的變化預作準備，不保證排除風險。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: on a case by case basis
options: A. 只依申請表字數排序
B. 在每個人出發後自動取消
C. 依每個個案分別判斷
D. 不看情況而一律同意
normal.explain: case by case 強調個案處理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The distinction is pertinent because it determines which process is available, not merely what the form is called.
options: A. 表格名稱已足以保證每種補救。
B. 區分很相關，因它決定可用程序，不只影響表格名稱。
C. 區分只改名稱而完全不影響程序。
D. 所有程序已被統一取消。
normal.explain: pertinent 指切題；區分有實際程序後果。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would be cautious about describing the response as adequate merely because every prescribed step has been completed.
options: A. 任何規定步驟都必定無用。
B. 說話者確認一個步驟也沒完成。
C. 我不會只因規定步驟全做完就把回應稱為充分。
D. 步驟完成已充分證明問題獲得解決。
normal.explain: 程序符合不自動等於實質充足，未否定程序價值。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The system accommodates routine cases reasonably well; the difficulty begins where the categories fail to capture what actually happened.
options: A. 系統已完全無法處理任何常規個案。
B. 每個實際情況都已清楚落入唯一分類。
C. 分類只影響外觀而不影響處理。
D. 系統對常規個案尚可，難題在分類無法涵蓋實際發生情況時開始。
normal.explain: 有限肯定常規表現，指出邊界案例的適配問題。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The operator can expedite the review, but cannot honestly promise that a faster review will reach a different conclusion.
options: A. 結論若相同就證明審查完全沒進行。
B. 說話者拒絕任何改進處理時間的可能。
C. 業者能加速審查，但不能誠實保證加快就會改變結論。
D. 加速審查已保證所有申請獲准。
normal.explain: 速度與結果分開，較快不等於較有利。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The process becomes circular when the only acceptable proof of failure is a record that the failing service was responsible for producing.
options: A. 任何證據都已被程序無條件接受。
B. 服務已完整提供所有所需紀錄。
C. 說話者只是在說表格必須畫成圓形。
D. 若只能靠出問題的服務本應產生卻未產生的紀錄證明失敗，程序就陷入循環。
normal.explain: 證明要求依賴失靈服務本身，造成實際取證障礙。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The language promises discretion at the point where the automated process has already made discretion practically unavailable.
options: A. 措辭在宣稱可裁量時，自動流程其實已使裁量難以實行。
B. 流程已把每個決定完全交給個人判斷。
C. 說話者認為所有自動化都不可能有規則。
D. 裁量權已被明文宣布沒有任何限制。
normal.explain: 名義權限與實際操作能力存在落差。

normal.desc: 【語意】The notice confirms eligibility, not entitlement to an immediate place. What distinction is made?
options: A. Meeting the criteria differs from having a guaranteed allocation now.
B. Every eligible applicant has already received a place.
C. No eligible person is allowed to apply.
D. Eligibility can only be established after a place is used.
normal.explain: 符合資格與已享有立即名額是不同狀態。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】The additional documents were requested to ___ processing, not to guarantee approval.
options: A. expatiate
B. expedite
C. expel
D. expend
normal.explain: expedite 是加快處理；加快不等於核准保證。

normal.desc: 【文法】Only after the discrepancy was pointed out ___ the two bookings had been treated differently.
options: A. had explained the agent why
B. the agent did explained why
C. did the agent explain why
D. the agent explained why
normal.explain: Only after 置首，主句用 did＋主詞＋原形；why 引導說明內容。

normal.desc: 【分詞構句】___ without the accompanying conditions, the assurance appeared broader than it was.
options: A. To have read it
B. Read
C. Reading
D. Having reading
normal.explain: assurance 是被閱讀對象，用過去分詞 Read。

normal.desc: 【短文】A service promises priority assistance to passengers who register in advance. The registration page closes before many passengers receive their tickets. What implementation problem arises?
options: A. Every passenger has registered before the page closes.
B. The promise has no relationship to the registration process.
C. Access to the promised priority depends on completing a step some users cannot yet take.
D. Priority assistance is explicitly available without any condition.
normal.explain: 所需程序可能早於使用者有條件完成的時間，阻礙取得承諾。

normal.desc: 【立場】The procedure is defensible in the abstract but poorly calibrated to the circumstances of delayed travellers. What is the criticism?
options: A. The procedure has no conceivable rationale in any context.
B. Delayed travellers are said to require no assistance.
C. The procedure is praised as responsive to every circumstance.
D. A generally justifiable process may be unsuitable for the situation in which it is applied.
normal.explain: 抽象合理性與情境適配分開，不全盤否定程序。

normal.desc: 【短文】A booking agent says a room is available, while the final confirmation remains pending. The traveller interprets this as an irrevocable guarantee. What has been conflated?
options: A. A request to cancel and a refusal to accept payment.
B. An arrival date and a departure time.
C. Current availability and a completed binding commitment.
D. The hotel’s location and its number of floors.
normal.explain: 可用狀態不等於完成且不可撤回的承諾。

normal.desc: 【短文】A provider advertises a seamless journey, while each subcontractor accepts responsibility only for its own segment. When a missed transfer occurs between segments, no party considers it within its remit. What gap is exposed?
options: A. Every segment has necessarily failed to operate.
B. The traveller has been given more responsibility than the contract states explicitly.
C. Subcontracting makes any successful journey impossible.
D. The advertised integrated experience lacks corresponding integrated responsibility.
normal.explain: 對外整體承諾與內部分段責任不對應，銜接處可能無人處理。

normal.desc: 【推論】The policy is clear only if one already knows which category the case falls into. What would most improve its practical usefulness?
options: A. Criteria and examples for deciding between the relevant categories.
B. A larger font for the category names alone.
C. A statement that categories never overlap under any circumstances.
D. Removal of every reference to the situations the policy addresses.
normal.explain: 應先解決適用分類的判斷，不只是增強既有標籤。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：與問題直接相關而切題的
請唸出單字：針對損害或不公所作的補救
請唸出：須依個案裁量的例外
請唸出：實質上充分的補救
請唸出：目前可用不等於不可撤回的承諾
normal.ans: CURRENT AVAILABILITY IS NOT AN IRREVOCABLE COMMITMENT
normal.speak: current availability is not an irrevocable commitment
normal.vocabId: R7:CURRENT AVAILABILITY IS NOT AN IRREVOCABLE COMMITMENT

normal.desc: 請唸出：程序必須容納常規以外的情況
normal.ans: THE PROCEDURE MUST ACCOMMODATE CIRCUMSTANCES BEYOND ROUTINE CASES
normal.speak: the procedure must accommodate circumstances beyond routine cases
normal.vocabId: R7:THE PROCEDURE MUST ACCOMMODATE CIRCUMSTANCES BEYOND ROUTINE CASES

normal.desc: 請拼出：遇到問題時可尋求的補救途徑（R 開頭，8 個字母）
請拼出：使程序更快速進行（E 開頭，8 個字母）
請拼出：一旦作出便不能撤回的（I 開頭，11 個字母）
填空題：R E M _ D Y (針對問題損害所提供的補救辦法)
填空題：A D M _ S S _ B L E (依程序規則可被接受的)
填空題：D I S _ R E _ A N _ I E S (多處原應相符資料之間的出入)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 完全沒有任何內容的沉默
B. 受到爭辯而未獲共同接受的主張
C. 已被所有人無條件承認的事實
D. 只能在比賽結束後提出的要求
normal.explain: contested 指有爭議，不自動表示主張錯誤。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 不含任何立場的摘要
B. 所有人同時撤回的承諾
C. 單方面作出的宣布
D. 雙方共同議定的條約
normal.explain: unilateral 指單方面，不是自動正當或不正當。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 在明白揭露一切條件後
B. 不以任何形式存在
C. 僅依地理位置排列
D. 以某種外表或名義出現
normal.explain: in the guise of 常暗示外表與實質不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The messenger’s confidence is not a substitute for knowing where the information originated.
options: A. 沒有信心的人不可能傳達真實消息。
B. 所有傳來的資訊都被證明虛假。
C. 信使有信心，不能取代查明資訊來源。
D. 只要信使自信，來源就已驗證。
normal.explain: 傳話態度與來源證據分開。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The offer restores access to the bridge while leaving the ruler free to close it whenever dissent is described as disorder.
options: A. 過橋權已被無條件永久保障。
B. 所有異議已明確不再受限制。
C. 統治者已放棄對橋的任何控制。
D. 提議恢復過橋，但仍讓統治者在把異議稱作騷亂時隨時關閉。
normal.explain: 恢復與保留關閉權共同限制承諾的穩定性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would distinguish obedience to an office from loyalty to the purpose for which the office exists.
options: A. 我會區分服從職位與忠於該職位存在目的。
B. 任何職位的目的都只在於服從。
C. 忠於目的必然表示反對每個命令。
D. 說話者拒絕承認任何共同責任。
normal.explain: 制度角色與其目的可以形成不同義務解讀。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A concession made under pressure can still improve the situation, though it should not be redescribed as spontaneous generosity.
options: A. 只要受到壓力，讓步就不可能帶來任何好處。
B. 讓步已證明完全沒有外在壓力。
C. 說話者認為改善結果必定證明善意動機。
D. 壓力下的讓步仍可改善情況，但不應改說成自發慷慨。
normal.explain: 效果與動機分開，保留改善但拒絕不當動機包裝。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The treaty’s apparent symmetry conceals a difference between the party that defines the exceptions and the party that must live with them.
options: A. 條約表面對稱，卻掩蓋誰界定例外、誰承受例外的差異。
B. 雙方已平等掌握所有例外定義與後果。
C. 條約沒有任何形式上的相似安排。
D. 只要文字對稱，實質權力就必定相同。
normal.explain: 文字對稱不等於實際權限與負擔對稱。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What looks like a restoration of trust may be no more than a temporary alignment of interests that leaves the original grievance intact.
options: A. 說話者斷言任何信任都完全不可能存在。
B. 看似恢復信任，可能只是利益暫時一致，原有不滿仍在。
C. 只要共同合作就已永久消除所有不滿。
D. 利益一致已證明雙方從未有過衝突。
normal.explain: 合作行為有替代解釋，may 保留可能性而不否定一切信任。

normal.desc: 【語意】The proclamation asserts authority rather than establishes its legitimacy. What is the distinction?
options: A. No claim to authority has been made.
B. Claiming a right to command differs from justifying that right.
C. The proclamation has offered a complete justification for every order.
D. Authority and legitimacy have been defined as the same concept.
normal.explain: 宣稱有權命令與證成該權力正當性不同。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】The council voted to ___ the decree and restore the previous arrangement.
options: A. resemble
B. reside
C. rescind
D. recite
normal.explain: rescind 是撤銷規定或決定；restore previous arrangement 支持撤銷的語意。

normal.desc: 【倒裝】Only when the villagers challenged the seal ___ that the letter had no recognised authority.
options: A. the steward admitted
B. had admitted the steward
C. the steward did admitted
D. did the steward admit
normal.explain: Only when 置首引發主句倒裝；did 後用原形 admit。

normal.desc: 【分詞構句】___ as a temporary safeguard, the restriction gradually became permanent.
options: A. Had introducing
B. Having introduced it
C. Introduced
D. Introducing
normal.explain: restriction 是被引入的限制，用過去分詞 Introduced。

normal.desc: 【短文】A guardian permits any traveller to appeal a decision, but hears appeals only in a language the affected villagers have been forbidden to learn. What undermines the promise?
options: A. The guardian has explicitly removed every appeal procedure.
B. The villagers have already won every appeal.
C. A shared language can never help people communicate.
D. Access to the formal opportunity is constrained by conditions the guardian imposes.
normal.explain: 名義上可申訴，實際條件卻阻止當事人使用。

normal.desc: 【語意】The captain’s allegiance is principled rather than personal. What is emphasised?
options: A. Commitment to a standard that may outlast a particular leader.
B. Commitment to any leader regardless of conduct.
C. A refusal to hold any consistent commitment.
D. A preference for private gain over every public duty.
normal.explain: principled 指依原則而非只依某人維持忠誠。

normal.desc: 【短文】A messenger swears that the warning is accurate but admits she has repeated it from another messenger. What remains uncertain?
options: A. Whether she has repeated any warning at all.
B. Whether all messages require written signatures.
C. Whether the warning concerns an event in the past or future, when no timing is given.
D. Whether the original information has been independently checked.
normal.explain: 傳遞者相信內容不等於獨立驗證來源；其餘不直接回應可靠性缺口。

normal.desc: 【短文】The ruler calls the silence of the square consent. The guards have just announced that dissenters will lose access to the market. Why is the inference weak?
options: A. The conditions give people a reason to remain silent without agreeing.
B. Silence has no possible communicative meaning in any context.
C. Every villager has explicitly rejected the decree.
D. The market is unrelated to any villager’s interests.
normal.explain: 異議成本提供沉默的替代解釋，不證明人人反對。

normal.desc: 【推論】The oath binds the captain to protect the village, yet the order requires abandoning its inhabitants to save the royal storehouse. What conflict arises?
options: A. The inhabitants and the storehouse are identical objects.
B. A direct command may conflict with the purpose of the prior obligation.
C. Protecting the village has been explicitly defined as saving only the storehouse.
D. The captain has made no commitment of any kind.
normal.explain: 命令與先前保護義務的目的有張力，非僅字面服從問題。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：未經正當授權而奪取權位
請唸出單字：否認與某行為主張有關的表態
請唸出：對自身正當性的主張
請唸出：可以被撤回的保證
請唸出：形式對稱可能掩蓋不均等的解釋權
normal.ans: FORMAL SYMMETRY CAN CONCEAL UNEQUAL POWERS OF INTERPRETATION
normal.speak: formal symmetry can conceal unequal powers of interpretation
normal.vocabId: R7:FORMAL SYMMETRY CAN CONCEAL UNEQUAL POWERS OF INTERPRETATION

normal.desc: 請唸出：真實危險不能證成無關限制
normal.ans: A GENUINE DANGER DOES NOT JUSTIFY UNRELATED RESTRICTIONS
normal.speak: a genuine danger does not justify unrelated restrictions
normal.vocabId: R7:A GENUINE DANGER DOES NOT JUSTIFY UNRELATED RESTRICTIONS

normal.desc: 請拼出：正式撤銷規定協議或決定（R 開頭，7 個字母）
請拼出：可供後續類似情況援引的先例（P 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：由一方單獨作出的（U 開頭，10 個字母）
填空題：P R O C L A _ A T I O N (正式公開發布的聲明)
填空題：C O _ R C _ O N (以威脅或壓力迫使人行動)
填空題：A _ L _ _ E (在尚未證實前提出某事屬實的指稱)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 不能分辨任何味道的狀態
B. 用來擺放餐具的托盤
C. 能敏銳辨別食物滋味好壞的味覺判斷力
D. 只願接受甜食的飲食限制
normal.explain: palate 在此比喻味覺辨別與品味。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 故意製造神祕感的料理
B. 完全沒有調理過的食物
C. 僅為炫耀昂貴食材而做的菜
D. 不故作高雅的料理
normal.explain: unpretentious 指樸實不裝腔，不等於未烹調。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 激起食慾或期待
B. 使所有食物泡濕
C. 徹底消除想吃的念頭
D. 把進餐時間一再延後
normal.explain: whet 是激起；不是同音 wet 的弄濕。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 要求全程沉默的氣氛
B. 讓人感到敵意的氣氛
C. 刻意保持距離的氣氛
D. 便於愉快交談共處的氣氛
normal.explain: convivial 指友善歡聚，常用於用餐社交。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The menu is concise, but I would hesitate to call it limited: almost every choice feels distinct.
options: A. 菜單精簡，但我不太會稱它選擇受限，因為各選項幾乎都具特色。
B. 菜單篇幅很長且每道菜都相同。
C. 說話者認為菜少必定沒有選擇。
D. 每個選項已被廚師刪除。
normal.explain: 區分 concise 的正面精簡與 limited 的負面不足。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What disappointed me was not the simplicity of the dish, but the lack of care with which it had been prepared.
options: A. 失望只因菜名不夠長。
B. 令我失望的是製作欠用心，不是料理簡單。
C. 說話者要求每道菜都必須複雜。
D. 簡單料理已被明確評為做得用心。
normal.explain: not ... but ... 確定批評對象為用心程度。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I can see why the dish attracts attention, though I suspect its novelty contributes more to its appeal than its flavour does.
options: A. 我理解它為何引人注意，但懷疑吸引力更多來自新奇而非滋味。
B. 說話者完全無法理解料理受到注意的原因。
C. 說話者認為吸引力完全來自熟悉的味道。
D. 說話者只在抱怨上菜時間。
normal.explain: 承認料理引人注意，同時比較新奇與滋味對吸引力的貢獻。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The claim of authenticity seems less a description of a stable tradition than an invitation to accept the chef’s preferred version of it.
options: A. 正宗一詞被解釋成食材重量。
B. 正宗的主張較像邀請接受主廚偏好的版本，而非描述固定傳統。
C. 主廚已證明只有一個從未改變的版本。
D. 說話者否定這道菜與任何傳統有關。
normal.explain: less ... than ... 重新界定話語功能，不證明全無傳統。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: For all the talk of innovation, the most convincing dish was the one that seemed least anxious to announce its originality.
options: A. 說話者認為原創菜一概不能成功。
B. 沒有任何人談到創新。
C. 雖然一直談創新，最有說服力的卻是最不急於宣示原創性的那道菜。
D. 最成功的菜靠反覆宣告創新取勝。
normal.explain: For all 表儘管；批評刻意宣示，不一概反對原創。

normal.desc: 【語域】Which description praises a restaurant’s lack of pretension rather than its luxury?
options: A. An exclusive venue whose grandeur dominates the experience.
B. A lavish setting with conspicuously expensive fittings.
C. An unassuming dining room with carefully cooked food.
D. An opulent room designed to impress visitors.
normal.explain: unassuming 表不擺架子；其餘著重豪華或排場。

normal.desc: 【文法】Much as I ___ the chef’s inventiveness, I found the combinations unbalanced.
options: A. am admiring of
B. have admiration
C. admiring
D. admire
normal.explain: Much as I admire ... 是讓步，承認欣賞但保留另一評價。

normal.desc: 【語意】The reviewer calls the menu coherent rather than merely comprehensive. What is praised?
options: A. The dishes form a considered whole, beyond offering a wide range.
B. The menu contains every dish the reviewer can name.
C. The descriptions are long enough to prevent any omission.
D. The dishes are unrelated but numerous.
normal.explain: coherent 強調整體有連貫安排；comprehensive 強調涵蓋廣。

normal.desc: 【字彙】A discerning diner is especially able to ___.
options: A. consume unusually large portions
B. prepare meals without a recipe
C. avoid expressing any preference
D. notice and judge differences in quality
normal.explain: discerning 指有敏銳辨別與判斷力，非食量或烹飪能力。

normal.desc: 【短文】A review calls the restaurant authentic because its décor resembles the reviewer’s childhood home. The chef questions whether appearance alone can establish culinary authenticity. What is challenged?
options: A. The criterion used to move from a personal visual association to a judgement about the food.
B. The reviewer’s right to remember a childhood home.
C. The possibility that décor affects any dining experience.
D. The claim that the chef has personal memories of the same house.
normal.explain: 檢視判準的適切性，不否定記憶本身或所有環境影響。

normal.desc: 【語意】The dessert is restrained, though hardly austere. What balance is conveyed?
options: A. It is plain precisely because restraint and austerity are identical.
B. It avoids excess without feeling severely plain.
C. It is elaborate to the point of overwhelming the meal.
D. It lacks any discernible flavour or pleasure.
normal.explain: restrained 不過度，hardly austere 否認嚴苛簡陋；兩者非同義。

normal.desc: 【指涉】The bread arrived warm; the soup, regrettably, did not. What is omitted after did not?
options: A. arrive warm
B. arrive at all
C. taste of bread
D. regret the delay
normal.explain: 省略承接 arrived warm；不能自行推為湯完全沒上桌。

normal.desc: 【短文】A restaurant reduces the number of courses but keeps the price unchanged. The chef says the change allows more attention to each dish. Which evaluation addresses the chef’s claim directly?
options: A. Whether an unchanged price proves that the dishes are unchanged.
B. Whether the greater attention produces an improvement diners can perceive.
C. Whether a higher course count is always preferable regardless of quality.
D. Whether the chef has ever visited another restaurant.
normal.explain: 主張連結減少菜數與提升品質，應檢查可感知改善。

normal.desc: 【立場】The critic concedes that nostalgia informs her judgement without treating nostalgia as a sufficient defence of an indifferent meal. What is her position?
options: A. Nostalgia has been entirely excluded from her response.
B. An indifferent meal is preferable whenever it evokes no memories.
C. Personal attachment matters but does not settle the assessment of quality.
D. Personal attachment renders all criticism of the meal illegitimate.
normal.explain: 承認影響，但不把情感當充分辯護。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：使人愉快交談共處的
請唸出單字：事物的來源或出處
請唸出：能區分細節而不一概而論的評價
請唸出：食用後仍留在口中的餘味
請唸出：簡單不必意味欠缺用心
normal.ans: SIMPLICITY NEED NOT IMPLY A LACK OF CARE
normal.speak: simplicity need not imply a lack of care
normal.vocabId: R7:SIMPLICITY NEED NOT IMPLY A LACK OF CARE

normal.desc: 請唸出：個人情感不能決定品質判斷
normal.ans: PERSONAL ATTACHMENT DOES NOT SETTLE A JUDGEMENT OF QUALITY
normal.speak: personal attachment does not settle a judgement of quality
normal.vocabId: R7:PERSONAL ATTACHMENT DOES NOT SETTLE A JUDGEMENT OF QUALITY

normal.desc: 請拼出：能敏銳辨別並判斷品質的（D 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：味道可口而容易接受的（P 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：樸實而不故作高雅的（U 開頭，13 個字母）
填空題：A F T E R _ A S T E (食用後留在口中的餘味)
填空題：S A _ O _ R (慢慢品味而充分享受)
填空題：O _ U _ E _ T (富麗堂皇而奢華的)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 已排除所有異議的定論
B. 完全沒有觀察就作的虛構
C. 正式撤回所有分類的方法
D. 可以隨證據修正的暫定辨識
normal.explain: tentative 是暫定而非無根據虛構。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 明顯而引人注意的缺席
B. 無人察覺的短暫出現
C. 不容易看清的斑點
D. 刻意增加的觀察次數
normal.explain: conspicuous 指醒目可注意；可修飾 absence。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只觀察自己倒影的人
B. 不顯眼且盡量不打擾的觀察者
C. 以大聲呼喊引人注意的觀察者
D. 完全沒有記錄的遊客
normal.explain: unobtrusive 強調不引人注意或造成干擾。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 缺乏其他佐證時
B. 所有獨立證據一致確認後
C. 觀察者全數到齊之際
D. 不准保存原始資料的情況
normal.explain: corroboration 指增加可信度的佐證。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We have a convincing description of one event, not yet a convincing account of how often it occurs.
options: A. 描述細節越多就必然發生越頻繁。
B. 我們有一次事件的可信描述，尚無其發生頻率的可信說明。
C. 一次記錄已足以確定全年頻率。
D. 事件本身已被證明未曾發生。
normal.explain: 事件存在與頻率推斷是不同層次。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The features are compatible with that identification, though none is distinctive enough to settle it on its own.
options: A. 所有特徵與辨識完全矛盾。
B. 沒有任何特徵曾被記錄。
C. 特徵符合那個辨識，但沒有一項單獨足以定案。
D. 每項特徵都單獨唯一確定該種類。
normal.explain: 相容不等於有獨特鑑別力；on its own 限定單一特徵。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The label is useful as a starting point, provided we do not let it dictate which details we notice.
options: A. 每個細節都已被證明同樣重要。
B. 標籤可當起點，只要不讓它決定我們留意哪些細節。
C. 標籤應先決定哪些不符細節必須刪掉。
D. 說話者拒絕使用任何標籤。
normal.explain: 分類的用途附有不讓預期篩掉觀察的條件。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What appears to be a boundary in the distribution may be a boundary in where people have thought it worth looking.
options: A. 物種已因觀察者到訪而開始往搜尋區域內遷移。
B. 地圖上的界線主要反映不同觀察者辨認能力的差異。
C. 看似物種分布界線，可能反映人們選擇搜尋的範圍。
D. 人們選擇搜尋範圍，已證實跟隨物種真實分布界線。
normal.explain: 資料空白可能反映搜尋分布，而非生物真實邊界。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The report is strongest where it describes the observations, and weakest where it quietly turns their interpretation into an established fact.
options: A. 報告細節太多而薄弱，刪除觀察才能凸顯解釋的優點。
B. 報告的解釋已有充分證據，只是描述觀察的文筆較弱。
C. 報告觀察本身不可信，但它提出的解釋可彌補這個問題。
D. 報告描述觀察較有力，把解釋當既定事實則削弱可信度。
normal.explain: 評價不同層次的證據強弱，非禁止推論。

normal.desc: 【文法】The more closely we observed the markings, ___ it became that the two birds were different.
options: A. clearer than
B. so clearly
C. the most clearly
D. the clearer
normal.explain: the more ..., the clearer ... 表相關程度變化。

normal.desc: 【字彙】A tentative identification should be understood as ___.
options: A. a provisional judgement open to revision
B. a deliberate attempt to mislead
C. a classification accepted without qualification
D. a refusal to make any observation
normal.explain: tentative 是暫定而可能修正，不等於捏造。

normal.desc: 【語意】The report distinguishes a resident population from occasional visitors. What distinction is central?
options: A. Living organisms versus preserved specimens.
B. Regular presence in the area versus intermittent appearance.
C. Large animals versus animals too small to observe.
D. Animals seen by experts versus those seen by volunteers.
normal.explain: resident 與 occasional visitors 對比在地持續性與偶爾出現。

normal.desc: 【語用】The observer writes, consistent with nesting activity, rather than, proof of nesting. What is achieved?
options: A. The interpretation remains compatible with alternatives.
B. The observation is withdrawn as fabricated.
C. The observer asserts a stronger level of certainty.
D. All possible explanations are listed exhaustively.
normal.explain: consistent with 是符合但非唯一證明，保留替代解釋。

normal.desc: 【短文】Volunteers report more sightings after an observation platform opens. The report treats this as a possible change in reporting effort rather than immediate evidence of population growth. What is being controlled conceptually?
options: A. The assumption that volunteers cannot keep records.
B. The distinction between how much observers look and how many animals exist.
C. The distinction between platform construction costs and admission prices.
D. The claim that no animals can be observed from a platform.
normal.explain: 觀察努力變化會影響紀錄量，不等同族群增長。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The pattern is suggestive of seasonal movement, though the observations do not cover a full year. Which qualification matters?
options: A. The report denies any pattern in the recorded period.
B. Seasonal movement has been ruled out by definition.
C. The available period may be too narrow to establish the proposed seasonal pattern.
D. The observations explicitly cover every season.
normal.explain: suggestive 保留推測；全年不足限制季節性論證。

normal.desc: 【短文】A rare plant is found beside a heavily used path. A commentator calls this proof that foot traffic benefits the species. Which untested possibility is most relevant?
options: A. Every visitor may have arrived by a different route.
B. The plant may persist there despite disturbance, rather than because of it.
C. The plant must be a different colour from those elsewhere.
D. The observers may have used a printed rather than digital map.
normal.explain: 共存不證明受益；despite 與 because 的差別是核心。

normal.desc: 【短文】A field guide offers sharply separated categories, while several observed birds show features associated with more than one category. The observer records the mixed features rather than forcing a label. What principle is illustrated?
options: A. The guide’s categories should take priority over uncertain observations.
B. A mixed appearance supports whichever category is most familiar.
C. Classification should preserve features that complicate its boundaries.
D. Mixed features should be recorded only once a new category is agreed.
normal.explain: 分類有用但不應刪去不吻合的資訊，沒有否定所有分類。

normal.desc: 【立場】The absence of a sighting is informative only in relation to the likelihood that a present animal would have been detected. What follows?
options: A. A failed search is stronger evidence when the species is difficult to see.
B. The length of a species name determines the weight of a failed search.
C. Search conditions affect successful sightings but not unsuccessful ones.
D. A failed search is stronger evidence when detection would have been likely.
normal.explain: 未發現的證據力與偵測機率有關，不是全無意義。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：隱晦而不易辨認的
請唸出單字：支持某說法的其他佐證
請唸出：仍可修改的暫定分類
請唸出：觀察方式造成的系統性偏差
請唸出：符合某解釋不證成它為真
normal.ans: COMPATIBILITY WITH AN EXPLANATION DOES NOT ESTABLISH ITS TRUTH
normal.speak: compatibility with an explanation does not establish its truth
normal.vocabId: R7:COMPATIBILITY WITH AN EXPLANATION DOES NOT ESTABLISH ITS TRUTH

normal.desc: 請唸出：表面界線可能反映觀察者搜尋範圍
normal.ans: THE APPARENT BOUNDARY MAY REFLECT WHERE OBSERVERS HAVE LOOKED
normal.speak: the apparent boundary may reflect where observers have looked
normal.vocabId: R7:THE APPARENT BOUNDARY MAY REFLECT WHERE OBSERVERS HAVE LOOKED

normal.desc: 請拼出：明顯而引人注意的（C 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：不引人注意或不造成干擾的（U 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：數量或程度上升下降的波動（F 開頭，11 個字母）
填空題：R E S I _ E N T (在某地長期居住或常駐的)
填空題：D I S _ E R _ A L (由原處向不同地點散布的過程)
填空題：A B _ N _ A _ C E (大量存在的狀態或數量)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 展現公平尊重對手精神的舉動
B. 刻意挑釁對方的動作
C. 正式登記比賽成績的程序
D. 提高個人訓練負荷的方法
normal.explain: sporting 可指大方公平而有運動精神。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 賽後才出現的新證據
B. 結果早已被視為可預知的事
C. 需要再三申訴的判決
D. 尚未訂定的賽事規則
normal.explain: foregone conclusion 指被視為必然的結果。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 不經比賽直接取得的資格
B. 敗方獲得額外積分的安排
C. 代價過大而得不償失的勝利
D. 實力相近所形成的平手
normal.explain: Pyrrhic victory 關鍵是勝利代價，非單指險勝。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 正在討論是否練習
B. 仍有爭取勝利或資格的機會
C. 已確定獲得最終冠軍
D. 因爭議而被禁止參賽
normal.explain: in contention 指仍在競逐，未必領先。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: His reaction was understandable, though that does not make the way he spoke to the official acceptable.
options: A. 說話者無法理解反應，因此反對所有申訴。
B. 裁判已因他的反應而正式改判。
C. 能理解他的反應，不代表能接受他對裁判的說話方式。
D. 說話者因理解原因而接受了他對裁判的態度。
normal.explain: 理解動機與認可行為可區分。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The format rewards taking risks, but only within a framework that limits how much one failed attempt can cost.
options: A. 賽制鼓勵冒險，並讓單次失敗決定全部結果。
B. 賽制只獎勵不冒風險而穩定完成的人。
C. 賽制已取消失敗紀錄以免影響結果。
D. 賽制鼓勵冒險，但框架限制單次失敗的代價。
normal.explain: 風險回報與損失限制並存。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would distinguish making the competition accessible from making every match equally easy to win.
options: A. 說話者認為應以難以報名來維持比賽品質。
B. 比賽的參與條件已被改成只接受優勝者。
C. 我會區分讓比賽容易參與與讓每場都同樣容易贏。
D. 比賽容易參與就應確保每個人同樣容易獲勝。
normal.explain: 可及性與勝負難度是不同目標。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The impressive result may owe something to the system, but the system was introduced just as several unusually strong players joined.
options: A. 強手加入已證明制度對成績沒有任何作用。
B. 制度早已推出多年，強手加入與結果毫無關聯。
C. 好成績已被確定完全是新制度造成。
D. 好成績可能部分來自制度，但制度推出時恰有幾位強手加入。
normal.explain: 同時發生的人員變動是替代影響，不排除制度部分功勞。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What looks like a failure of commitment may be a failure to offer a schedule that people with other commitments can actually manage.
options: A. 看似投入不足，可能是時程未顧及人們其他責任。
B. 參加者已承認缺席只是因為不喜歡活動。
C. 時程安排合理與否可由出席低直接證明。
D. 人們只要足夠投入就能取消任何其他責任。
normal.explain: commitment 的投入/既有責任雙義形成重評，不確定指責個人。

normal.desc: 【語意】The team’s dominance was short-lived. Which account matches this?
options: A. They led briefly before other teams caught up.
B. They remained unbeaten throughout several seasons.
C. They entered few events but won every one.
D. They improved gradually without ever taking the lead.
normal.explain: short-lived 指維持不久；dominance 是優勢地位。

normal.desc: 【文法】So evenly ___ that no side led by more than a point.
options: A. the teams were matching
B. matched were the teams
C. the teams matched were
D. were matched the teams
normal.explain: So evenly matched were the teams that ... 程度詞前置倒裝；matched 作分詞形容狀態。

normal.desc: 【語域】Which comment concedes defeat without diminishing the winners’ achievement?
options: A. They won, although anyone could have done so in those conditions.
B. Their victory owes more to our mistakes than to their play.
C. We had opportunities, but they made better use of theirs.
D. The result says more about our bad luck than their ability.
normal.explain: 正答承認雙方機會與對手較佳把握；其餘將勝利貶為幸運或對方失誤。

normal.desc: 【文法】He insisted on ___ as a beginner, despite his previous experience.
options: A. having treat
B. being treated
C. treating him
D. be treated
normal.explain: insist on 後用動名詞；主詞 he 接受對待，用 being treated。

normal.desc: 【短文】A club removes rankings to reduce pressure but still allocates its best time slots according to recent results. What tension remains?
options: A. The best time slots are now distributed without considering results.
B. Removing rankings has necessarily made players more competitive.
C. Competitive outcomes still determine access to a desirable benefit.
D. The club has eliminated every practical consequence of performance.
normal.explain: 明面排名取消，資源分配仍依成績；不推論心理必然更競爭。

normal.desc: 【語意】Her composure should not be mistaken for indifference. What is being distinguished?
options: A. Remaining calm from being able to understand the rules.
B. Caring about the outcome from following the rules.
C. Showing disappointment from having practised regularly.
D. Remaining calm from caring little about the outcome.
normal.explain: composure 是鎮定，不等於不在乎。

normal.desc: 【語用】I am not convinced the new format rewards consistency quite as much as its designers suggest. What is the speaker questioning?
options: A. The designers’ willingness to describe the format publicly.
B. Whether any player has ever performed consistently.
C. The extent to which the format favours steady performance.
D. Whether the format contains any scoring rules at all.
normal.explain: not ... quite as much 降低程度，非否定一致表現存在。

normal.desc: 【短文】A coach praises a risky move when it succeeds and condemns the same decision when it fails, without considering the information available beforehand. What distinction would improve the assessment?
options: A. A player’s willingness to listen versus the coach’s experience.
B. The complexity of a move versus the time available after the match.
C. The crowd’s reaction versus the official record of the score.
D. The quality of a decision versus the outcome of a single attempt.
normal.explain: 評估決策應看當時資訊，不只以單次成敗倒推。

normal.desc: 【立場】The captain accepts that a rule was technically followed while disputing that the action was sporting. What does she preserve?
options: A. A distinction between formal compliance and fair conduct.
B. A claim that the official score must therefore be incorrect.
C. A requirement that every sporting action produce a close result.
D. A distinction between individual and team competitions.
normal.explain: 規則符合與運動精神判斷不同，不自動推翻比數。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：壓力下保持冷靜的鎮定
請唸出單字：利用規則邊緣手段取得心理或競賽優勢
請唸出：容許判斷空間的裁量決定
請唸出：需要投入不少時間精力的承諾
請唸出：鎮定不應與漠不關心混淆
normal.ans: COMPOSURE SHOULD NOT BE CONFUSED WITH INDIFFERENCE
normal.speak: composure should not be confused with indifference
normal.vocabId: R7:COMPOSURE SHOULD NOT BE CONFUSED WITH INDIFFERENCE

normal.desc: 請唸出：好決策仍可能得到不幸結果
normal.ans: A GOOD DECISION CAN STILL HAVE AN UNFORTUNATE OUTCOME
normal.speak: a good decision can still have an unfortunate outcome
normal.vocabId: R7:A GOOD DECISION CAN STILL HAVE AN UNFORTUNATE OUTCOME

normal.desc: 請拼出：對他人有禮大方而體諒的（G 開頭，8 個字母）
請拼出：有機會爭取勝利或職位的競逐者（C 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：展現公平競爭精神的（S 開頭，8 個字母）
填空題：S E E _ I N G (依實力排名安排賽事位置的做法)
填空題：F O _ F _ I T (因違規或未履行條件而喪失權利或比賽)
填空題：O _ T _ L _ Y (在比賽表現上勝過對手)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 正式撤回先前全部支持
B. 附有條件或保留的支持
C. 具備專業資格者的任何聲明
D. 沒有任何保留的全力支持
normal.explain: qualified 在此是受限定的，不是專業資格。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 經宣誓逐字承認
B. 尚未有人聽見的傳言
C. 未明說卻隱含承認
D. 以正式文件明確否認
normal.explain: tacit 指未直接表達而由行為語境暗示。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 內含過多數字的問題
B. 已下載到裝置的問題
C. 完全無法用口語表達的問題
D. 帶有未獲接受預設的問題
normal.explain: loaded question 帶有立場或預設，不能只看句長。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 內容已確定為真的爆料
B. 只為增加字數的標題
C. 措辭謹慎的免責或限制聲明
D. 未經閱讀便轉傳的引文
normal.explain: disclaimer 用以限制責任、適用範圍或關聯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The quotation is genuine; the impression created by placing it next to that photograph is another matter.
options: A. 照片是真的，所以旁邊引文也已獲證實。
B. 引文已被證明偽造，照片則尚待查核。
C. 只要引文正確，任何並列方式都不影響解讀。
D. 引文是真的，但與那張照片並列所產生的印象需另論。
normal.explain: 單項真實性與組合框架效果分開。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would take her silence as a reason to ask, not as permission to announce her agreement.
options: A. 我會因她沉默而去問，不會據此宣布她同意。
B. 我會先宣布同意，再請她說明反對理由。
C. 她沉默已足以確認不同意，無需再問。
D. 詢問只會改變她原本已明示的同意。
normal.explain: 沉默不足以替他人宣告同意，也未定為反對。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The summary preserves the conclusion while quietly discarding the qualifications that made it a cautious one.
options: A. 摘要刪掉結論，只保留過多限制條件。
B. 摘要原封保留結論與所有保留措辭。
C. 原文沒有結論，所以摘要自行另寫一個。
D. 摘要保留結論，卻刪去原本使其審慎的限定。
normal.explain: 刪去 qualifications 提高語氣確定性，不代表結論文字變動。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The report may be accurate sentence by sentence while remaining misleading in the pattern of what it chooses not to mention.
options: A. 逐句正確仍可能因選擇性省略而誤導。
B. 逐句正確已足以排除誤導，剩下問題只是報告篇幅不夠長。
C. 因省略本來就屬必要編輯，所以報告的取捨不需要另行檢視。
D. 報告之所以誤導，是因省略部分使已寫出的每句話都成為假話。
normal.explain: 事實正確與資訊選擇完整公允不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The interviewer’s challenge sounds forceful, but it accepts the premise that the dispute is only about how the policy is presented.
options: A. 說話者認為追問框架足以挑戰政策，但語氣不夠堅定有力。
B. 追問語氣強硬，框架卻只容許爭議在呈現方式。
C. 追問不但挑戰政策呈現，也已明確否定政策本身的合理性。
D. 採訪者先接受政策內容，來賓後來才說爭議只在呈現方式。
normal.explain: 語氣強弱不等於問題框架觸及實質。

normal.desc: 【語意】The article attributes the estimate to an unnamed source. What does it establish?
options: A. The article withdraws the estimate because nobody has agreed to be named.
B. The article identifies the estimate as coming from someone whose name it withholds.
C. The article confirms the estimate using a source whose identity is publicly documented.
D. The article presents the estimate as the reporter’s own calculation from published data.
normal.explain: attribution 是標明來源，unnamed 是未公開姓名，不等於已獨立驗證。

normal.desc: 【文法】The editor requested that the qualification ___ in the headline.
options: A. is retain
B. had retaining
C. be retained
D. was retaining
normal.explain: request that 後用原形虛擬式；qualification 被保留。

normal.desc: 【語用】A host responds, That is one way of putting it, after a guest describes a disputed decision as obvious. What is the likely implication?
options: A. The host confirms that no other wording is possible.
B. The host requests a literal translation into another language.
C. The host withdraws the question because the answer was inaudible.
D. The host leaves room for a different characterisation.
normal.explain: That is one way ... 常委婉表示另一種看法，無需斷言完全反對。

normal.desc: 【文法】The reporter denied ___ the quotation out of context.
options: A. had taken
B. have taking
C. having taken
D. to have taken
normal.explain: deny 後接動名詞；having taken 指先前被指控的行為。

normal.desc: 【短文】A report says that a witness disputed one detail of an account. Its headline says the witness rejected the account. What has changed?
options: A. A disagreement about detail has become an endorsement.
B. A first-hand account has become an anonymous rumour.
C. A public statement has become a private exchange.
D. A limited disagreement has become a broader rejection.
normal.explain: disputed one detail 範圍較小，headline 擴大拒絕範圍。

normal.desc: 【語意】The correction is conspicuous, though the withdrawal of the underlying allegation is conspicuously absent. What is the criticism?
options: A. A visible factual correction leaves the central accusation standing.
B. The central accusation has been withdrawn without any visible correction.
C. The correction is hidden while the accusation is prominently withdrawn.
D. Both the correction and the accusation have disappeared from the article.
normal.explain: 平行 conspicuous/absent 突出有改細節卻未撤核心指控。

normal.desc: 【短文】An interviewee says a plan could work if staffing increases. A summary reports that she said the plan could work, omitting the staffing condition. What is lost?
options: A. A guarantee that more staff will be recruited.
B. A statement that the interviewee opposes the plan.
C. A prediction that current staff will leave.
D. A condition limiting the claim’s applicability.
normal.explain: 省略 if 條件使有條件可行變得較無條件。

normal.desc: 【短文】A presenter gives equal speaking time to two guests, then describes one guest’s claims as evidence and the other’s as allegations without explaining the difference. What should a listener examine?
options: A. Whether the framing privileges one position despite equal airtime.
B. Whether equal airtime requires both guests to make identical claims.
C. Whether the guests were invited in the same order as they spoke.
D. Whether longer airtime would make the factual claims easier to verify.
normal.explain: 篇幅形式平等與措辭帶來的可信度不對稱不同。

normal.desc: 【指涉】The source denied suggesting that the decision was final, not that a decision had been discussed. Which denial is supported?
options: A. The source confirms having recommended the decision.
B. The source rejects having implied finality.
C. The source rejects any knowledge of a discussion.
D. The source confirms that the decision is now final.
normal.explain: 否定範圍在 suggesting final，不是否定有討論。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：以含蓄暗示傳達負面指控的話
請唸出單字：限制責任或適用範圍的聲明
請唸出：未明說但彼此理解的默契
請唸出：明顯而值得注意的遺漏
請唸出：否認針對簽名而非授權
normal.ans: THE DENIAL ADDRESSES THE SIGNATURE RATHER THAN THE AUTHORISATION
normal.speak: the denial addresses the signature rather than the authorisation
normal.vocabId: R7:THE DENIAL ADDRESSES THE SIGNATURE RATHER THAN THE AUTHORISATION

normal.desc: 請唸出：相同播出時間不必表示相同框架
normal.ans: EQUAL AIRTIME NEED NOT MEAN EQUIVALENT FRAMING
normal.speak: equal airtime need not mean equivalent framing
normal.vocabId: R7:EQUAL AIRTIME NEED NOT MEAN EQUIVALENT FRAMING

normal.desc: 請拼出：以不同措辭重述同一意思（P 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：表達刊物立場的社論（E 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：把某行為或動機歸於某人（I 開頭，6 個字母）
填空題：D E N _ A L (聲稱某事不屬實或與己無關的否認)
填空題：C A _ E _ T (對某說法附加的警告或限制)
填空題：E _ C _ R _ T (由較長作品摘出的片段)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 禁止任何後續修改的安排
B. 已被放棄而未採用的想法
C. 正式解方到位前的權宜措施
D. 為永久消除問題所作的保證
normal.explain: stopgap 是暫時補位，不保證永久解決。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只出於同情而未動工的計畫
B. 把原特色全部換掉的重建
C. 不考慮使用情境的仿製品
D. 尊重原有特色的修復
normal.explain: sympathetic 在修復語境指與原有性質協調。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 分次零碎處理的方式
B. 一次整體規劃並完成的方式
C. 只靠口頭而未執行的討論
D. 把所有工作交由同一人的安排
normal.explain: piecemeal 是逐塊分次，常暗示缺乏整體性，但不必完全無規劃。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 大家已同意的共同目標
B. 不需討論的次要背景
C. 為了開始會議而訂的時間
D. 引起爭議的問題
normal.explain: contention 在此是爭論。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am not attached to the chair itself; I object to finding that somebody has decided on my behalf that I no longer need it.
options: A. 我不執著椅子本身，而是反對別人代我決定我不再需要它。
B. 我只在意保留椅子，不在意是誰決定搬走。
C. 我已請別人替我決定，卻不滿他們沒有執行。
D. 椅子屬於大家，所以我認為只能由我處理。
normal.explain: 爭點從物件偏好轉到替他人決策的權限。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The proposal is economical on paper, though it assumes everyone can contribute time as readily as money.
options: A. 說話者認為出時間不應被視為任何貢獻。
B. 提案帳面上省錢，但假設每人都能像出錢般輕易出時間。
C. 提案較花錢，卻能保證每個人節省同樣時間。
D. 提案已把不同人的可用時間逐一換成金額。
normal.explain: 節省金錢的可行性依賴未經檢驗的時間資源假設。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would call the change reversible only if putting things back is a realistic option, not merely a theoretical possibility.
options: A. 只有實際能恢復而非理論上可能，我才稱改動可逆。
B. 只要理論上能恢復，是否有資源執行並不重要。
C. 說話者認為改動一經完成就永遠無法回復。
D. 恢復後必須看起來更好，才可稱為可逆。
normal.explain: reversible 的實用標準須看可執行性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The disagreement is less about tidiness than about who gets to define what counts as clutter in a shared space.
options: A. 說話者認為只要訂清潔時間就已解決定義問題。
B. 爭議較關乎誰有權定義共用空間的雜物，而非整潔本身。
C. 雙方對雜物定義完全一致，只爭執誰該出錢。
D. 其中一方明確要求共用空間不應有任何物品。
normal.explain: 定義與決策權是核心，不只物品是否整齊。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The new arrangement distributes inconvenience more evenly, which may be why those previously spared it are the least enthusiastic.
options: A. 原本免受不便者因而成為最熱烈支持者。
B. 大家同樣不熱衷，證明新安排並沒有改變。
C. 新安排較平均分攤不便，可能因此讓原本免受者最不熱衷。
D. 新安排把不便集中給原本受最多影響的人。
normal.explain: may 推測阻力來源，先前無負擔者如今需分擔。

normal.desc: 【語意】The renovation is sympathetic to the original design. What is praised?
options: A. The new design copies a different building more closely.
B. The project has restored every feature without alteration.
C. The changes respect the character of the earlier design.
D. The builders feel sorry for the people who designed the building.
normal.explain: sympathetic to design 指與原風格相協調，不保證逐件原樣復原。

normal.desc: 【文法】The sooner we agree on priorities, ___ time we will waste debating individual purchases.
options: A. less than
B. the least of
C. so little
D. the less
normal.explain: the sooner ..., the less ... 對應程度變化，time 不可數。

normal.desc: 【語用】I am all for improving the room, but I had hoped to recognise it afterwards. What is implied?
options: A. The speaker thinks the proposed changes go too far.
B. The speaker opposes any improvement to the room.
C. The speaker needs a label to identify the room’s address.
D. The speaker wants the completed room to be unrecognisable.
normal.explain: 先表支持，幽默地指出改造超出接受範圍。

normal.desc: 【文法】No amount of new storage ___ the disagreement about whose things may be moved.
options: A. resolve
B. are resolving
C. have resolved
D. resolves
normal.explain: 主詞 No amount ... 為單數；真正問題是移動權限。

normal.desc: 【短文】One resident says the common room is underused; another says it offers a quiet retreat precisely because it is not always occupied. What is disputed?
options: A. Whether low occupancy amounts to a lack of value.
B. Whether residents can physically enter the room.
C. Whether the room was designed for sleeping.
D. Whether every resident has the same key.
normal.explain: 使用價值不必只以占用率衡量，兩方對 underused 的判準不同。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The room is available subject to prior agreement on its use. What does this imply?
options: A. Only people who attended the previous meeting may enter.
B. Access depends on an arrangement made beforehand.
C. Any resident may use it first and seek approval later.
D. The room’s use has been permanently settled already.
normal.explain: subject to 引條件，prior 指先取得，不指定哪些人。

normal.desc: 【短文】A housemate treats the absence of objections as permission to replace shared furniture. Others say they had not been told a decision was imminent. What assumption is challenged?
options: A. That silence following insufficient notice amounts to informed agreement.
B. That replacing shared furniture can ever improve the room.
C. That the old furniture belongs to someone outside the household.
D. That a decision can be made before new furniture is delivered.
normal.explain: 沒有充分告知時的沉默不必是知情同意。

normal.desc: 【短文】A designer calls a room flexible because its furniture can be moved. Residents say moving it requires strength and time they do not have. What distinction matters?
options: A. The cost of new furniture versus the space occupied by old furniture.
B. The possibility of reconfiguration versus its practical availability to users.
C. The designer’s choice of colour versus the residents’ preferred decoration.
D. The room’s original purpose versus the date when the furniture was bought.
normal.explain: 形式上可變與使用者能否做到不同，題目未談顏色預算。

normal.desc: 【立場】The report praises consistency of style but questions whether consistency has become an excuse to disregard individual needs. What is the concern?
options: A. Consistency has been rejected as an aesthetic goal in every setting.
B. The building’s users have been given control over all design decisions.
C. Aesthetic coherence may be taking priority over usable variety.
D. Individual needs have been shown to require identical designs.
normal.explain: 承認美學優點但質疑優先序，不一概否定一致風格。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：適合人居住的
請唸出單字：提升使用舒適便利的設施
請唸出：可恢復原狀的介入改動
請唸出：未明說的所有權主張
請唸出：實用彈性取決於使用者實際能改什麼
normal.ans: PRACTICAL FLEXIBILITY DEPENDS ON WHAT USERS CAN ACTUALLY CHANGE
normal.speak: practical flexibility depends on what users can actually change
normal.vocabId: R7:PRACTICAL FLEXIBILITY DEPENDS ON WHAT USERS CAN ACTUALLY CHANGE

normal.desc: 請唸出：同等任務數可能掩蓋不等負擔
normal.ans: AN EQUAL TASK COUNT MAY CONCEAL UNEQUAL DEMANDS
normal.speak: an equal task count may conceal unequal demands
normal.vocabId: R7:AN EQUAL TASK COUNT MAY CONCEAL UNEQUAL DEMANDS

normal.desc: 請拼出：以現有物品臨時拼湊的（M 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：整修翻新以改善狀況（R 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：逐漸侵入他人空間或權益（E 開頭，8 個字母）
填空題：U P H O L _ T E R Y (家具表面的布料填充與包覆物)
填空題：H A B I _ A B I _ I T Y (適合居住的程度或狀態)
填空題：R E _ R _ F _ T (為舊設備或建物加裝新功能)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 保證情況絕不變動的正式承諾
B. 事情結束後才作的成效摘要
C. 沒有具體用途的額外裝飾
D. 為可能變動預作的備援安排
normal.explain: contingency arrangement 用以應對特定可能情況。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 讓相關人士提供意見的程序
B. 由一人不經討論直接決定的程序
C. 只公布既定結果而不收回應的公告
D. 以抽籤代替所有討論的辦法
normal.explain: consultative 指諮詢，不保證每份意見都被採納。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 必定違反規定而不能執行的工作
B. 費力而少獲感謝的工作
C. 完全不用付出時間的任務
D. 被所有人爭相要求的獎勵
normal.explain: thankless 指辛苦卻不受賞識，不等於違規。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 象徵性或金額很小的貢獻
B. 以實際支出全額計算的付款
C. 不具名而且無法記錄的捐贈
D. 必須由主辦者親自完成的工作
normal.explain: nominal 在此指很小或象徵，不是不具名 anonymous。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The consultation may be genuine, but it is difficult to see what remains open when the venue, date and format have all been fixed.
options: A. 諮詢真誠已保證所有既定安排都會被取消。
B. 諮詢可能真誠，但場地日期形式已定，難看出還能改什麼。
C. 場地日期形式尚未定，所以諮詢完全沒有方向。
D. 說話者已證實主辦者根本沒有詢問任何意見。
normal.explain: 不直接指控虛假，質疑可影響的實質範圍。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am happy to coordinate the replies, provided that does not quietly turn into being responsible for every arrangement.
options: A. 我已接受所有安排工作，只要求別人代收回覆。
B. 我不願與任何人聯繫，也不接受協調角色。
C. 我願協調回覆，只要不悄悄變成負責全部安排。
D. 我願負責全部安排，但不想知道誰會回覆。
normal.explain: 同意特定任務並防止責任不明擴張。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We should distinguish declining a particular task from withdrawing support for the event.
options: A. 說話者建議先取消活動，再請大家選擇工作。
B. 應區分拒絕某項任務與撤回對活動的支持。
C. 拒絕某項任務已充分表示不支持活動本身。
D. 只要支持活動，就等於同意任何後來追加的工作。
normal.explain: 任務界線不等於對總目標的態度。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What looks like effortless hospitality from the audience may depend on a remarkable amount of effort that the programme never acknowledges.
options: A. 接待之所以自然，已證明志工不需要事先準備。
B. 說話者認為只有被公開列名的工作才有實際價值。
C. 觀眾眼中自然輕鬆的接待，可能仰賴節目未提及的大量幕後付出。
D. 節目已完整承認所有工作，所以觀眾看出接待很費力。
normal.explain: 外顯輕鬆與幕後勞動並存；未被承認不等於沒價值。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The invitation is generous in what it offers participants, rather less so in what it assumes organisers can supply indefinitely.
options: A. 邀請限制參加者所得，反而對主辦者提供過多補助。
B. 主辦者已明示所有資源無限，因此邀請沒有負擔問題。
C. 說話者只質疑邀請文字是否用了過多讚美形容詞。
D. 邀請對參加者大方，對主辦者卻預設能無限供應，較欠體諒。
normal.explain: 兩方角度的 generosity 評價不同，指出隱藏假設。

normal.desc: 【語意】The programme is ambitious rather than merely busy. What is emphasised?
options: A. The number of unrelated items already completed.
B. The organisers’ unwillingness to remove any item.
C. The amount of free time left between sessions.
D. The scale of what it aims to achieve.
normal.explain: ambitious 重點是企圖與目標尺度，非只是項目多。

normal.desc: 【文法】The organiser proposed ___ the final session optional.
options: A. making
B. to making
C. make it
D. that making
normal.explain: propose doing 表提議做某事，making session optional。

normal.desc: 【語用】I would be reluctant to promise that without first asking the people who would have to deliver it. What is withheld?
options: A. An admission that the speaker has attended the meeting.
B. A commitment made on behalf of an unconsulted team.
C. A description of work the team has already completed.
D. A request for the team to explain its preferred approach.
normal.explain: 不願未諮詢執行者就代作承諾，不等於拒絕詢問。

normal.desc: 【文法】Had the availability survey been circulated earlier, we ___ the clash.
options: A. might have avoided
B. will avoid
C. had avoiding
D. might avoid yesterday
normal.explain: 過去反事實條件倒裝，主句 might have avoided。

normal.desc: 【短文】A committee asks for suggestions but announces the final programme before replies are due. Members wonder what the consultation could have changed. What is questioned?
options: A. Whether the committee had enough chairs for its meeting.
B. Whether the process allowed input to influence the decision.
C. Whether every member was entitled to receive an invitation.
D. Whether suggestions should be submitted as complete programmes.
normal.explain: 時間順序使實質影響空間存疑，非直接斷定所有成員被拒。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The support is offered on the understanding that the event remains free to attend. What would require renewed agreement?
options: A. Adding a free break between sessions.
B. Moving the reply deadline a day earlier.
C. Introducing an admission charge.
D. Changing the colour of the programme.
normal.explain: on understanding that 是承諾條件，收費會改變關鍵前提。

normal.desc: 【語用】It would help if the invitation distinguished between being welcome to contribute and being expected to do so. What distinction is requested?
options: A. A contribution in writing versus one made aloud.
B. An opportunity versus an obligation.
C. An invitation versus a notice of cancellation.
D. An experienced participant versus a beginner.
normal.explain: welcome to 可參與，expected to 有期待或責任感。

normal.desc: 【短文】Every volunteer receives the same briefing. Some are then assigned tasks requiring information the briefing never covered. The organiser cites equal treatment as proof of adequate preparation. What is the flaw?
options: A. Adequate preparation requires identical tasks for every volunteer.
B. The briefing’s length is the only reliable measure of its value.
C. Identical provision does not establish suitability for different roles.
D. Different roles necessarily require entirely separate organisations.
normal.explain: 相同資訊不等於符合各角色需求，非要求全部分開。

normal.desc: 【立場】The review values spontaneity but objects to making participants absorb the costs of decisions described as spontaneous. What is criticised?
options: A. Allowing any unscheduled interaction between participants.
B. The suggestion that planning can ever coexist with spontaneity.
C. The participants’ preference for deciding their own arrival times.
D. Using spontaneity to excuse transferring avoidable burdens to others.
normal.explain: 批評以自發作藉口轉嫁負擔，不否定自由互動。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：協助不同群體聯繫協調的人
請唸出單字：被委派角色的職責範圍
請唸出：原先未預料到的要求
請唸出：人數有限的志工群
請唸出：相同簡報未必足以準備不同角色
normal.ans: IDENTICAL BRIEFINGS MAY NOT PREPARE PEOPLE FOR DIFFERENT ROLES
normal.speak: identical briefings may not prepare people for different roles
normal.vocabId: R7:IDENTICAL BRIEFINGS MAY NOT PREPARE PEOPLE FOR DIFFERENT ROLES

normal.desc: 請唸出：成功救場不證成原計畫健全
normal.ans: A SUCCESSFUL RESCUE DOES NOT VINDICATE THE ORIGINAL PLAN
normal.speak: a successful rescue does not vindicate the original plan
normal.vocabId: R7:A SUCCESSFUL RESCUE DOES NOT VINDICATE THE ORIGINAL PLAN

normal.desc: 請拼出：透過詢問相關人士意見的（C 開頭，12 個字母）
請拼出：對某目的而言不可缺少的（I 開頭，13 個字母）
請拼出：使某過程較容易或順利進行（F 開頭，10 個字母）
填空題：B R _ E F (對任務目的與要求的指示)
填空題：H O N _ R A _ I U M (為服務或演說致謝而付的酬金)
填空題：A C K _ O W L _ D G E _ E N T (對協助或貢獻公開致謝的表達)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 能引起豐富聯想的片段
B. 已完整記錄所有細節的總結
C. 失去一切可辨資訊的碎屑
D. 被判定毫無情感效果的引文
normal.explain: evocative 指能喚起感受或記憶。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 已被確定是蓄意造假的複本
B. 部分依推測完成的重建
C. 完全未作任何改動的原件
D. 由作者親自提供的逐字說明
normal.explain: conjectural 不等於完全無根據或偽造。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 不准轉售的共同持有協議
B. 缺少中間一代資料的繼承紀錄
C. 沒有已知中斷的所有權沿革
D. 由同一個人製作的金屬鏈
normal.explain: chain of ownership 比喻前後相接的持有歷史。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The scratch is slight, but the owner can tell you exactly when and how it happened.
options: A. 刮痕已修好，所以沒有留下相關記憶。
B. 刮痕很小，但主人能確切說出何時如何造成。
C. 刮痕很深，主人卻完全不記得來源。
D. 主人知道物件來處，但不知刮痕何時出現。
normal.explain: 物理痕跡程度與故事清楚程度不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What interests me is not that the object survived untouched, but that successive owners kept finding reasons to alter and retain it.
options: A. 主人每次改動後都立即丟棄物件，因此有趣。
B. 說話者認為保存物件必須禁止所有後人使用。
C. 我感興趣的是歷代主人不斷改用並保存，而非未改原樣留存。
D. 我只重視物件未改原樣，改動使它失去價值。
normal.explain: survival 可透過持續使用改動，不只靜態原封保存。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The family story may be substantially right even if the date attached to it has drifted over time.
options: A. 日期有偏移已證明家族故事從未發生。
B. 日期準確，所以故事每項細節都已獨立查證。
C. 家族故事的價值只取決於日期是否最早。
D. 家族故事大體可能正確，即使相關日期隨傳述有偏移。
normal.explain: 局部記憶不準不自動否定整體，may 保留可能。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The display invites nostalgia, but the letters beside it make that nostalgia rather less comfortable.
options: A. 展覽完全避開過往，信件則只描述未來。
B. 旁邊信件因與展品無關而被要求移走。
C. 展覽引人懷舊，但旁邊信件讓懷舊不那麼舒適。
D. 信件消除所有懷舊，讓人只感到厭惡。
normal.explain: 情感被複雜化而非完全取消，less comfortable 指不安。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The object’s ordinariness is precisely why it matters: it records a kind of life that more ceremonial objects can leave out.
options: A. 物件因普通而缺乏價值，只能作典禮物件的替代品。
B. 普通與典禮物件已被確定記錄完全相同的生活。
C. 物件的重要性只在於它比典禮物件數量更少。
D. 物件正因普通而重要，記錄了典禮物件可能漏掉的生活。
normal.explain: ordinary 可提供不同生活史視角，非以華麗稀有判價值。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The curator is not asking us to distrust memory, but to notice how a memory can be sincere and still change its emphasis over a lifetime.
options: A. 策展人非要求不信任記憶，而是注意真誠記憶仍可能隨人生改變重點。
B. 策展人認為記憶只要真誠就不會有任何變化。
C. 記憶重點改變已證明敘述者故意騙人。
D. 策展人只願使用從未經本人敘述的紀錄。
normal.explain: 真誠與重點變化可共存，非全盤抹除記憶。

normal.desc: 【語意】The provenance is documented only from the object’s arrival at the museum. What remains uncertain?
options: A. Its history before it entered the museum.
B. Whether the museum has recorded receiving it.
C. Whether the object is currently in a museum collection.
D. The existence of documentation after its arrival.
normal.explain: only from 限定紀錄起點，更早沿革未明。

normal.desc: 【文法】The portrait is thought ___ before the family moved away.
options: A. that it painted
B. to have been painted
C. to have painting
D. having been paint
normal.explain: is thought to have been painted 表據信先前被繪成。

normal.desc: 【語用】The guide says the room is remarkably unchanged, then points to a modern security camera. Which interpretation is most reasonable?
options: A. The modern camera proves that all earlier features have been replaced.
B. The guide is retracting every claim about the room’s earlier appearance.
C. The room largely retains its character despite a functional addition.
D. The guide claims that the camera was part of the original furnishing.
normal.explain: unchanged 可作整體描述，語境明示例外，非絕對原封。

normal.desc: 【文法】The drawer contained several letters, none of ___ had been catalogued.
options: A. that
B. which
C. them
D. whose
normal.explain: 逗號後非限定關係子句，none of which，不能用 them 接兩個完整子句。

normal.desc: 【短文】An exhibition places a worn apron next to a ceremonial uniform. The labels describe both as evidence of working lives, rather than treating only one as historically significant. What is the curatorial move?
options: A. Replacing historical interpretation with a list of clothing sizes.
B. Treating the ceremonial uniform as an object with no history.
C. Broadening the kinds of labour made visible through objects.
D. Claiming that all forms of work required the same clothing.
normal.explain: 並列日常與典禮物件擴大可見勞動，不是抹平差異。

normal.desc: 【語意】The restoration is conjectural in places. What should visitors understand?
options: A. Every part has been copied exactly from surviving original material.
B. The whole object has been proved unrelated to its stated period.
C. The repairs were made without anyone examining the surviving object.
D. Some details depend on informed reconstruction rather than direct evidence.
normal.explain: conjectural 部分依推測重建；in places 不等於全件虛構。

normal.desc: 【語用】The label says attributed to rather than made by. What difference does the wording mark?
options: A. The artist has formally denied making the object.
B. The maker’s name has been removed to protect privacy.
C. The maker’s identity is proposed with qualification.
D. The object is a deliberate copy made by the named artist.
normal.explain: attributed to 表歸屬推定，made by 較直接確定。

normal.desc: 【短文】A memoir describes an old kitchen as the centre of family life. Letters written at the time refer frequently to arguments there. The curator keeps both accounts. What does this permit?
options: A. The letters can be used to prove that nobody ever felt affection for the kitchen.
B. The memoir can replace the letters because later memory is always more complete.
C. The curator can avoid interpretation by declaring the two sources identical.
D. A later affectionate memory can be read alongside a more conflicted contemporary record.
normal.explain: 保留時間視角與矛盾複雜性，不用一份完全消滅另一份。

normal.desc: 【立場】The essay values an object’s capacity to evoke a past without treating the feeling of recognition as proof that the past has been accurately recovered. What distinction matters?
options: A. Emotional resonance versus historical verification.
B. An object’s age versus its current selling price.
C. A visitor’s education versus the curator’s qualifications.
D. A written label versus an audio description of the same words.
normal.explain: 共鳴與事實核實不同，可有共鳴仍需證據。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：盡量逼近原件外觀的複製品

請唸出：能喚起聯想的並置
請唸出：事後回看時的理想化
請唸出：真誠記憶可能隨時間改變重點
normal.ans: A SINCERE MEMORY MAY CHANGE ITS EMPHASIS OVER TIME
normal.speak: a sincere memory may change its emphasis over time
normal.vocabId: R7:A SINCERE MEMORY MAY CHANGE ITS EMPHASIS OVER TIME

normal.desc: 請唸出：情感共鳴不證成歷史準確性
normal.ans: EMOTIONAL RESONANCE DOES NOT ESTABLISH HISTORICAL ACCURACY
normal.speak: emotional resonance does not establish historical accuracy
normal.vocabId: R7:EMOTIONAL RESONANCE DOES NOT ESTABLISH HISTORICAL ACCURACY

normal.desc: 請拼出：能強烈引起感受或聯想的（E 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：依推測而非確切證明的（C 開頭，11 個字母）

🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 因沒認出對方而拒絕接待
B. 熱情洋溢的歡迎
C. 勉強維持禮貌的招呼
D. 未表任何情緒的通知
normal.explain: effusive 是情感外露而熱烈。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 因設備故障被迫終止活動
B. 完全不影響談話意思的空白
C. 充滿未說出口意味的停頓
D. 專為育兒安排的休息時間
normal.explain: pregnant 比喻充滿意義或可能性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 以盛大儀式進入會場
B. 因未獲許可而無法入場
C. 建築內唯一能辨識的出口
D. 不太引人注意地進場
normal.explain: inconspicuous 表不顯眼，不等於非法或被拒。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I said I recognised the house, not that I knew which of its three doors we were supposed to use.
options: A. 房子只有一個入口，所以認不認得都無關。
B. 我已用過每道門，只是不想再進入屋內。
C. 我認得房子，不等於知道該用三道門的哪道。
D. 我認得三道門，所以確定不知道是哪棟房子。
normal.explain: 整體熟悉與具體操作資訊可不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: She was gracious enough not to mention that the story I was telling was the one she had told me the week before.
options: A. 她指出我把上週故事改錯，所以我停止說話。
B. 我們各自在同一天獨立想出完全相同的故事。
C. 說話者特意先說明故事由她提供並向她致謝。
D. 她大方地沒指出，我正在講的是她上週告訴我的故事。
normal.explain: 善意不揭穿來源倒置，未交代說話者是否故意冒名。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: His expression suggested that the explanation had answered a question, though perhaps not the question he had actually asked.
options: A. 表情暗示解釋確有回答某問題，但未必是他問的那個。
B. 表情確認他完全沒聽到解釋，所以打算重問。
C. 解釋已完全回答原問題，只是他想再追問細節。
D. 說話者認為任何解釋都不應含有問題。
normal.explain: 承認可能有內容但與真正提問偏離，perhaps 保留。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The apology was prompt, which was fortunate, since it arrived a moment before I discovered what he was apologising for.
options: A. 我發現問題很久後，他才終於肯道歉。
B. 他不知道自己為何道歉，所以請我解釋。
C. 道歉來得太早，因此已阻止任何事情發生。
D. 他道歉很及時，剛好在我發現需道歉的事前一刻。
normal.explain: 順序是先道歉後知事件；fortunate 可幽默減少衝突。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: He told the story as if he had been a reluctant participant, although every practical detail depended on arrangements he had made himself.
options: A. 他講得像勉強被捲入，但每個安排細節其實由他親自促成。
B. 他已承認自己主導，所以敘述與實際安排一致。
C. 安排都由別人完成，他只是記住每個實用細節。
D. 說話者認為只要參與安排就一定享受所有結果。
normal.explain: 自我定位被動與實際策劃主動有張力，不推論所有情緒。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The joke depends on our noticing what the narrator seems determined not to notice about himself.
options: A. 讀者必須知道故事外的作者生平才會理解幽默。
B. 笑點靠我們看出敘述者似乎不肯察覺的自身問題。
C. 笑點完全靠敘述者明白說出自己每項缺點。
D. 敘述者刻意向讀者解釋笑點，所以再無言外之意。
normal.explain: 敘述者盲點與讀者理解差形成反諷，不要求外部背景。

normal.desc: 【語意】The host’s welcome was effusive. Which description fits?
options: A. She offered a practical explanation without any greeting.
B. She expressed delight with conspicuous enthusiasm.
C. She acknowledged the guest with restrained courtesy.
D. She avoided recognising the guest despite noticing him.
normal.explain: effusive 指熱情外露甚至洋溢，不是內斂客氣。

normal.desc: 【文法】Hardly had I set down the cup ___ someone knocked it over.
options: A. that
B. as if
C. when
D. than
normal.explain: Hardly had ... when ... 表剛做某事就發生另一事。

normal.desc: 【語用】Do come whenever you like, said the host, before consulting a notebook to list the evenings she would prefer him not to. What creates the humour?
options: A. The host has forgotten how to read her own notebook.
B. The guest has arrived on an evening already ruled out.
C. The notebook contains no information about evenings.
D. The broad invitation is immediately narrowed in practice.
normal.explain: whenever 與接著列限制形成反差，未說來賓已犯規。

normal.desc: 【文法】The bag, together with its contents, ___ exactly where she had left it.
options: A. have been
B. are being
C. was
D. were
normal.explain: 主詞 bag 單數，together with 不使主詞變複數。

normal.desc: 【短文】The narrator insists that he felt no jealousy, then recounts the rival’s new coat, better seat and louder applause in meticulous detail. What invites doubt?
options: A. The narrator has admitted jealousy directly in the same sentence.
B. The rival’s coat proves that he arranged the applause himself.
C. Detailed description necessarily means the narrator witnessed every event.
D. The attention he gives the rival sits awkwardly with his denial.
normal.explain: 敘述注意力與自稱無嫉妒有張力，未直接證明蓄意欺騙。

normal.desc: 【語意】She accepted the explanation with a politeness that did not quite amount to belief. What is distinguished?
options: A. A courteous response from inward conviction.
B. A written acceptance from an oral explanation.
C. An accurate memory from a convincing performance.
D. A willingness to listen from permission to remain.
normal.explain: 外在禮貌不等於內在相信。

normal.desc: 【文法】Her smile was the only indication ___ she had recognised him.
options: A. which
B. whose
C. what
D. that
normal.explain: indication that ... 為同位/內容子句，交代跡象指向何事。

normal.desc: 【短文】The narrator calls the neighbour impossible, but the only examples are occasions when she refused requests that inconvenienced her. What should a reader consider?
options: A. The judgement may reflect the narrator’s frustration at not getting his way.
B. The neighbour must have misunderstood every request before refusing it.
C. The narrator’s examples prove the neighbour is hostile in every setting.
D. The neighbour’s refusals establish that the requests were never made.
normal.explain: 人格標籤可能源於自利視角，未斷定鄰居全部行為皆合理。

normal.desc: 【語用】I am sure you meant well, says a character while moving the rearranged objects back to their former places. What is conveyed?
options: A. The intervention is welcomed because it requires no further discussion.
B. Good intentions are acknowledged without accepting the intervention.
C. The new arrangement has been accepted as a permanent improvement.
D. The speaker doubts that the objects have been moved at all.
normal.explain: 言語善意肯定配行動撤回，區分意圖與接受結果。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：不輕易透露想法的沉默寡言
請唸出：面對情況仍鎮定自持的能力
請唸出：以低調方式表達的責備
請唸出：能透露問題的前後不一致
請唸出：有禮回應不必等於內心相信
normal.ans: A COURTEOUS RESPONSE NEED NOT AMOUNT TO INWARD CONVICTION
normal.speak: a courteous response need not amount to inward conviction
normal.vocabId: R7:A COURTEOUS RESPONSE NEED NOT AMOUNT TO INWARD CONVICTION

normal.desc: 請唸出：敘述者把自身主動寫成勉強參與

normal.speak: the narrator presents his own initiative as reluctant involvement
normal.vocabId: R7:THE NARRATOR PRESENTS HIS OWN INITIATIVE AS RELUCTANT INVOLVEMENT

normal.desc: 請拼出：情感熱烈而外露的（E 開頭，8 個字母）
請拼出：不顯眼而不易引人注意的（I 開頭，13 個字母）
